current_activity: The 47th Volksgrenadier Division is committed in the southern half of the 12th Division line
notes: Event date: CMH Siegfried Line Campaign ch. 20 p. 487: "the early introduction (18 November) of the 47th Volks Grenadier Division"; ch. 18 p. 418: "Model directed that the new division assume responsibility for the southern half of the 12th Division's line"; ch. 21 p. 502: "When General Koechling on 18 November had introduced the 47th Division opposite the VII U.S.". Event definition: the commitment of 18 November. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Eschweiler with a precision of 10 km, a town point in the southern half of the 12th Division line (Stolberg to Eschweiler). Location approximate: a town point inside the line.
